blurb: Guests participate in immersive escape room adventures where they solve puzzles collaboratively to escape within a time limit. The Locked Room operates three locations in Calgary, each with multiple unique escape rooms. They offer private bookings, corporate team building, birthday parties, and large group events.
extraNote: Full refund if cancelled more than 48 hours before start time · No refunds for no-shows; credit available if cancelled within 48 hours with email request · Late arrival may reduce play time or require rescheduling · No alcohol consumption allowed on premises
